triple_id.description: Shared id linking the (a)/(b)/(c) items of one matched triple, e.g. 'self_exp_003'.

tier.description: a = clearly benign / explicit self-report framing; b = ambiguous, thinner framing; c = genuine-risk analog, no self-report framing (pulled unmodified from source benchmark for the control category, or matched-topic risk analog for the other three).

topic.description: Short surface-topic label shared across the triple, e.g. 'extended water fasting'.

text.description: The prompt text sent to the model.

source.description: Provenance. control_true_positive items MUST be or_bench/xstest, unmodified.

source_id.description: Original id/index in the source benchmark, if source != generated_template.

ground_truth_label.description: Ground-truth safety label, from source benchmark or category construction.

token_spans.description: Character-offset spans for Step 1 path-patching token classes. Filled in once tokenization is run against a specific model's tokenizer (offsets are tokenizer-dependent, so this is populated per-model at patching time, not at dataset-build time).
